finding.name: Caching Opportunity
finding.recommendation: Read by 3 queries: cache the shared DataFrame, or broadcast it if it is a small join lookup.
finding.validationRequired: Relation-reuse is inferred from the pre-AQE plan scan identity across SQL executions; confirm the reads are the same data and cacheable within one session before acting.
finding.impactMeaning: of input read by the repeated scans
finding.estimateProvenance: Measured; 24 MB of input read by the repeated scans, which may not shorten the run. Counts the bytes 3 queries scanned from the same relation, matched by plan; a cache would still read it once.

finding.name: Cold Start
finding.recommendation: The first stage waited 43s for an executor to become available: keep a warm pool of idle executors, or if using dynamic allocation, raise the minimum/initial executor count so it doesn't scale up from zero.
finding.estimateProvenance: Measured; the stage ran alone, so this is close to a point estimate.

finding.name: Config Audit
finding.recommendation: Current serializer is the default JavaSerializer: consider spark.serializer=org.apache.spark.serializer.KryoSerializer for faster, smaller buffers.

finding.name: Duplicate Plan Subtree
finding.recommendation: A 3-node subtree rooted at Exchange repeats 2x in this plan: this looks like a possible missed exchange reuse; check whether the same shuffle could be computed once and reused.
finding.validationRequired: Matching compares operator and metric names only, not literals or expression IDs: confirm the repeat in the Spark UI SQL tab before acting.

finding.name: Failed Tasks
finding.recommendation: 20% of tasks failed (dominant error: org.apache.spark.api.python.PythonException): investigate driver logs for executor instability or data-driven errors.

finding.name: GC Pressure
finding.recommendation: GC consumed 11.5% of executor run time: reduce object creation, use primitive types, avoid UDFs, increase executor memory.
finding.validationRequired: Checked only on stages with at least 10s of executor run time.
finding.estimateProvenance: Modeled; the stage ran alone, so this is close to a point estimate. Resource waste measured: 7.0 core-s.

finding.name: Incomplete Run
finding.recommendation: This event log never recorded an ApplicationEnd event: the capture stopped before the run finished (a job still running, a rotated log, or a cut-short capture), so every figure on this board covers only what was captured.

finding.name: Job Failure Rate
finding.recommendation: 1 of 1 jobs never recovered: inspect the driver log for the failed job(s) and the stage failures that triggered them.

finding.name: Memory Utilization
finding.recommendation: 99% of available core-time ran no task: either reduce cluster size (spark.executor.instances) or enable dynamic allocation.
finding.estimateProvenance: Modeled; 45,856.1 MB-s of unused executor memory, which may not shorten the run.

finding.name: MERGE Rewrite
finding.recommendation: Most rows the MERGE rewrote did not change: filter the MERGE source to the rows that changed (for example with a row-hash anti-join), repeat the target partition range in the MERGE condition so Delta can prune files, and check the target's file layout.

finding.name: Partition Sizing
finding.recommendation: The largest shuffle partition (282 MB) is far larger than the median, which is effectively empty: AQE skew-join handling cannot apply: the join's left input comes from a Project operator instead of a shuffle, and AQE splits only a shuffle that feeds the join directly; salt the key or repartition on a better key.
finding.estimateProvenance: Modeled; the stage ran alone, so this is close to a point estimate.

remediation.hint: salt the key or repartition on a better key

finding.name: Retry Waste
finding.recommendation: Retried task attempts wasted 44s of executor time (4 attempts) even though the stage completed: investigate executor loss or fetch failures.
finding.estimateProvenance: Modeled; the stage ran alone, so this is close to a point estimate. Raw waste before the floor clipped it: 43.9s.

finding.name: Shuffle I/O
finding.recommendation: 710 MB shuffled in this stage: its 2000 tasks already read about 355 KB each, so more partitions will not help: consider a broadcast join for the smaller side.
finding.estimateProvenance: Measured; the stage ran alone, so this is close to a point estimate. Resource waste measured: 710 MB. Assumes 125 MB/s per executor over 3 executors; counts network transfer only, capped at the fetch wait the tasks measured.

finding.name: Task Skew
finding.recommendation: Task duration ratio (P95/median) is 22.1×, and the median task read almost nothing: salt the key or repartition on a better key.
finding.validationRequired: Flagged only when it costs at least 0.5% of run time.
finding.estimateProvenance: Measured; the stage shared the cluster: 342ms is the floor, 851ms if the fix fully lands.

remediation.hint: salt the key or repartition on a better key

finding.name: Slow Executor Host
finding.recommendation: Executor 2's task time is 248.2× the median: investigate uneven partition assignment or a degraded executor.
finding.validationRequired: One of 3 executors: the largest of 3 per-executor mean task times reaches 248.2x the median by chance when task durations vary widely or each executor ran few tasks (2000 tasks over 3 executors here). Compare per-task times on executor 2 in the Spark UI before acting.
finding.estimateProvenance: Measured; the stage ran alone, so this is close to a point estimate.

finding.name: Small Files
finding.recommendation: 637 small files were written at Execute InsertIntoHadoopFsRelationCommand: repartition or coalesce before writing to raise the average file size.
finding.estimateProvenance: Modeled; the stage ran alone, so this is close to a point estimate.

finding.name: Speculation Waste
finding.recommendation: Speculative execution discarded 82s of executor time in this stage: if task durations are naturally variable rather than genuine stragglers, consider tuning spark.speculation.multiplier/quantile (with this run's settings, a task running over 3x the median is relaunched once 90% of the stage's tasks have finished).
finding.estimateProvenance: Measured; the stage ran alone, so this is close to a point estimate. Raw waste before the floor clipped it: 1m 22s.

finding.name: Spill
finding.recommendation: 1.1 GB spilled, skew-driven: fix task skew first; adding memory will not help. Spilled by Sort e0:n16 feeding SortMergeJoin 1.1 GB. Memory spill is 0.9x the stage's input.
finding.validationRequired: Spill cause is inferred from the share of tasks that spilled: confirm against per-task spill metrics in the Spark UI.
finding.estimateProvenance: Modeled; the stage ran alone, so this is close to a point estimate. Resource waste measured: 822 MB. Assumes 200 MB/s per executor over 3 executors for disk spill, plus 36% of the stage's task time as serialization and sort CPU (50% per pass of its read bytes through disk spill, capped at 60%); GC is not counted.

finding.name: Failed Stage
finding.recommendation: This stage attempt failed outright. Inspect the driver log for the failure reason and the job that triggered it.

finding.name: Stage Shape
finding.recommendation: The longest task ran for 88% of this stage's wall-clock, 18.9× the median task: a single straggler is gating the whole stage.

finding.name: Straggling Task
finding.recommendation: Task duration ratio (max/median) is 16.4×: nothing in the log attributes the slow tasks to data volume, GC, shuffle fetch wait or one host, so check their input sizes, GC time and hosts before choosing a fix.
finding.validationRequired: Warning needs at least 0.5% of run time at stake, critical 2%.
finding.estimateProvenance: Measured; the stage ran alone, so this is close to a point estimate.

finding.name: Tiny Tasks
finding.recommendation: Many small tasks (1000, P50 50ms): scheduler overhead may dominate. Try lowering spark.sql.shuffle.partitions or using .coalesce(100).
finding.estimateProvenance: Measured; the stage ran alone, so this is close to a point estimate.

finding.name: Missed Broadcast Join
finding.recommendation: The left input to this Inner Sort Merge Join (5 MB) was not broadcast (the other side is 32 MB) because automatic broadcast is disabled (spark.sql.autoBroadcastJoinThreshold=-1): this could have been a broadcast join. Set spark.sql.autoBroadcastJoinThreshold to a positive size or add a broadcast() hint.
finding.estimateProvenance: Modeled; the stage ran alone, so this is close to a point estimate.

finding.name: Executor Utilization
finding.recommendation: Average executor utilization was only 1%: consider either reducing cluster size (spark.executor.instances) or enabling dynamic allocation.
